import hashlib,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from mission_control.hypit_studio_project import snapshot_current
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d); text='synthetic frozen Run'; hashes={'build.svrun':hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()}; value={'revision':1,'run':{'path':'build.svrun'},'source':{'path':'build.svrun','files':[{'path':'build.svrun','text':text}]},'tracks':[]}
 assert snapshot_current(p,hashes,dict(root=list(hashes)[0],files=list(hashes)),value) is value

checks.name: changed-source-denied
checks.run:
import hashlib,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from mission_control.hypit_studio_project import sources_current
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d); names=['build.svrun','runtime.json','package.json']; hashes={}
 for name in names:
  (p/name).write_bytes(b'current'); hashes[name]=hashlib.sha256(b'old').hexdigest()
 rejected=False
 try: sources_current(p,hashes)
 except ValueError: rejected=True
 assert rejected
